scenes.basis: 21:1 "came near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives"
21:10 "When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up"
21:12 "Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple"
21:17 "He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there"
21:18 "in the morning, as he returned to the city... a fig tree by the road" - the roadside between Bethany and Jerusalem has no id
21:23 "When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching"
